name: Skills page loads
steps: Verify skills page loads with skill list
expected: Skills page loads showing available skills

name: Create skill (agent scope)
expected: Skill created, appears in skill list, visible only for current agent

name: Create skill (all scope)
expected: Skill created with 'all' scope, visible when switching to different agents

name: Edit skill content
steps: Click on a skill to open it
expected: Skill content updated and persists after reopening

name: Delete skill
expected: Skill deleted, no longer appears in skill list

name: Duplicate skill name rejected
steps: Try to create a skill with the same name as an existing one
expected: Duplicate name rejected with clear error message

name: Skill sidebar preview renders markdown
preconditions: At least 1 skill with markdown content
steps: Click on a skill in the list
Verify markdown (headers, bold, code blocks, lists) renders correctly
expected: Sidebar preview renders markdown formatting correctly
